newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lam Soon (HK) and unit resume trading.
newsitem.headline: Lam Soon (HK) and unit resume trading.

text.p: Lam Soon (Hong Kong) Ltd and its subsidiary Lam Soon Food Industries Ltd said the board meeting convened on Monday to approve the companies' 1996 results has been adjourned until March 26.
Trading in the shares of the two companies was resumed on Monday afternoon at 0630 GMT, the companies said in a joint statement issued through the exchange.

Trading had been suspended on Monday morning at the companies' request pending the announcement of possible capital restructuring exercises by both Lam Soon (Hong Kong) and the listed subsidiary company,
The directors of both companies are still considering these capital restructuring proposals and a further announcement would be made as soon as possible, the statement said.
